hooks.name: readme-test-count
hooks.description: When a test file is saved, run the tests and sync the test count stated in README.md.

hooks.name: readme-test-count-on-delete
hooks.description: When a test file is deleted, re-run the tests and sync the README test count.

hooks.name: readme-test-count-on-create
hooks.description: When a test file is created, run the tests and sync the README test count.
